name: Lavender
summary: Scent for the wardrobe, a feast for bees.
description: Lavender is a fragrant flowering perennial loved by pollinators.
usefulInformation: Dry flowers for sachets; use food-grade lavender sparingly in recipes.
healthBenefits: Lavender aroma may promote relaxation for some people; evidence varies.
medicinalUses: Used traditionally in aromatherapy; essential oil should not be ingested.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
